title: CMN GUI Lead and sole GUI-tooling responsibility
summary: Functional technical leadership and sustained ownership of coherent-mesh GUI tooling from CMN-800 onward.
role: CMN GUI Lead (functional responsibility; formal title Senior Software Engineer)

dates.note: The supplied analysis places CMN GUI work beginning in 2022; exact lead-role start is not independently established.

facts.text: CMN GUI Lead, solely responsible for creating and maintaining all CMN GUI tooling in Interconnect Architect from CMN-800 onward.
Created GUI tooling for Multi-CHI port devices, MCS group configuration, custom routing and mesh deadlock investigation.
Cyprus is the internal name for CMN-800; Delphi was the most recent CMN release at the October 2026 clarification, with no public equivalent or exact date supplied.

notes: CMN GUI Lead is a functional responsibility within the formal Senior Software Engineer title, not a separate promotion or people-management claim.
Sole responsibility is bounded to CMN GUI tooling; shared renderer/test components, hardware IP and Configuration Engine algorithms retain separate authorship.
